catalog-numeral.purpose: P-07 in the plate gutter; 2.25rem in compact.

answer.purpose: Suggested answer read aloud; 2.125rem at >=1200px container, 1.75rem compact.

question-en.purpose: English question on the plate; 1.125rem in compact.

question-es.purpose: Spanish translation under the English; 0.9375rem in compact.

body.purpose: Default UI text and column headers.

label.purpose: Footer privacy line, hints, small buttons.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: The system is flat; depth is tonal plus 1px seams. Only an inset 1.5px ring draws the idle status dot.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Button background and border colour only; disabled under reduced motion.

components.name: Button
components.description: Transparent control with a seam border.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.375rem 0.875rem; background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--seam, #305040); border-radius: 6px; color: var(--ink, #dcd8c8); font: inherit; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--wall-raised, #143024); border-color: #6f8a79; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #e0bf7c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Brass fill; one per bar (Iniciar / Pausar).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.375rem 0.875rem; background: var(--brass, #c9a45c); border: 1px solid var(--brass, #c9a45c); border-radius: 6px; color: var(--brass-ink, #0f261b); font: 600 inherit/1.5 inherit; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #d4b06b; border-color: #d4b06b; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #e0bf7c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Toggle Button (pressed)
components.description: aria-pressed state: 18% brass tint with brass border.
components.css: .ds-btn-pressed { min-height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.375rem 0.875rem; background: color-mix(in oklab, #c9a45c 18%, #0f261b); border: 1px solid #c9a45c; border-radius: 6px; color: #dcd8c8; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-pressed:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e0bf7c; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Field
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 0.5rem 0.625rem; background: var(--wall-raised, #143024); border: 1px solid var(--seam, #305040); border-radius: 6px; color: var(--ink, #dcd8c8); font: inherit; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #9bab9f; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #e0bf7c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Question Plate
components.description: Signature: catalogue numeral in the gutter, English over Spanish.
components.html:
P-07

Tell me about a time you led a team.

Cuéntame de una vez en que lideraste un equipo.
components.css: .ds-ficha { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0,1fr); column-gap: 1.25rem; padding: 1.5rem 1.5rem 0.75rem; background: #163325; border: 1px solid #305040; border-radius: 2px; color: #dcd8c8; font-family: 'Public Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-no { margin: 0; font-size: 3.5rem; line-height: 1; font-weight: 200; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #c9a45c; } .ds-p { color: #9bab9f; } .ds-en { margin: 0; font-size: 1.625rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.28; text-wrap: balance; } .ds-es { margin: 0.625rem 0 0; font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1.4; max-width: 52ch; }

components.name: Suggested Answer
components.description: Largest running text, set directly on the wall; gaps highlighted in brass tint.
components.html: I led a team of [número de personas] and shipped on time.
components.css: .ds-answer { margin: 0; max-width: 30em; font-family: 'Public Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 420; line-height: 1.42; text-wrap: pretty; color: #dcd8c8; } .ds-gap { padding: 0 0.15em; border-radius: 3px; background: color-mix(in oklab, #c9a45c 22%, transparent); color: #dcd8c8; }

components.name: Alert
components.description: Clay-outlined error with action; clay is for errors only.
components.html: Cuota agotada. Intenta de nuevo en unos minutos.
components.css: .ds-alert { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem 0.75rem; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #e8a08a; border-radius: 6px; color: #e8a08a; font-family: 'Public Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-alert p { margin: 0; flex: 1 1 18ch; } .ds-alert-btn { background: transparent; border: 1px solid #e8a08a; border-radius: 6px; color: #e8a08a; padding: 0.375rem 0.875rem; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-alert-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e0bf7c; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Bar
components.description: Status dot and text on the left, controls right, seam beneath.
components.css: .ds-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem 0.75rem; padding: 0.625rem 1.25rem; background: #0f261b; border-bottom: 1px solid #305040; color: #b2bcae; font-family: 'Public Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-dot { width: 0.625rem; height: 0.625rem; border-radius: 50%; background: #c9a45c; } .ds-status { flex: 1; } .ds-bar-btn { min-height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.375rem 0.875rem; background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; color: #dcd8c8; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-bar-btn:hover { background: #143024; } .ds-bar-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e0bf7c; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The screen is a gallery wall, not a dashboard. Each interviewer question is an exhibit with a catalogue number (P-07) and a plate that carries English above and Spanish below. The wall is deep ink green, never gray. Pieces are separated by 1px seams, not cards, and nothing casts a shadow. Type is a calm institutional grotesque in muted bone, with brightness held low because the user reads at night, on a call, and must not give the tool away on camera.

Hierarchy comes from scale and weight, not colour. The suggested answer is the largest running text on the screen because it is read aloud; the question plate carries equal weight at a glance. Brass is the single accent: it marks listening, the primary action and the catalogue numeral. Clay is reserved for errors. One layout serves two densities: a full wall of transcript and focus columns, and a floating compact mode where the transcript folds behind a toggle.
keyCharacteristics: Ink-green wall, one raised plate, 1px seams as the only dividers.
No shadows. Depth is tonal (wall, wall-raised, plate) plus hairline borders.
Single typeface (Public Sans Variable), contrast through a large scale jump (15px to 32px) and a 200-weight numeral.
Brass as sole accent; clay only for errors; partial text sinks to the quiet green-gray.
Density switches by container query, not by viewport media query.

rules.name: The One Metal Rule
rules.body: Brass is the only accent and clay the only alarm. A third hue means the system has been left.

rules.name: The Partial Sinks Rule
rules.body: Unfinished text is Quiet Sage; final text is Bone Ink. Never differentiate with motion or glow.

rules.name: The Answer Is Loudest Rule
rules.body: The answer is the largest running text on any surface; nothing else exceeds it except the numeral, which is light and brief.

rules.name: The Seam Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separate with a 1px seam or a tonal step. Never a shadow, never a card inside a card.

dos: Do keep the wall green (#0f261b family); lift with Raised Wall or Plate Green, never with gray.
Do keep the answer the largest running text and cap it at 30em.
Do switch density with the `app` container query at 759px, not viewport media queries.
Do render the numeral as `P-` in Quiet Sage plus digits in brass, tabular, weight 200.
Do show the 2px Focus Brass outline on every focusable control.
donts: Don't add shadows, glows or flicker; nothing may blink or shine on camera.
Don't introduce a second accent or use clay for anything but errors.
Don't nest cards or put the answer in a bordered box.
Don't use pure white or pure black text; the brightest value is Bone Ink.
